description: Receiver traces for keel.provisioned-direct-grant.v1. Each case is independent. U is a UI actor, P is a proxy, H is a represented principal, and W is a receiving actor. Assume a structurally valid message, current core signer authentication, applicable scope, configured time and audience policy, and independently trusted provisioning except where a step varies one of these. Requirement IDs refer to the extension proposal. Recursive proof validation (DA10 and DA11) belongs to a separately selected future profile.

cases.name: direct core and attribution-only participation

steps.event: In ordinary core scope X, P requests read under its own authorized policy. Repeat with on_behalf_of H.
expect: Both cases use ordinary authorization of P
H gains no authority and no grant verifier is consulted

cases.name: both peers provision a direct grant and admit a represented opening

steps.event: U, P and W sign as themselves. Provision separate U-to-P and P-to-W scopes with the respective grants. Try sending before bilateral readiness.
expect: No work before activation

steps.event: Activate both guards on each scope. P signs a read of doc-x to W within its matching active association.
expect: W verifies the certified P key and matches the granted permission and resource
W accepts the opening and reports taken:new-turn
W retains P as signer and H as subject

cases.name: grant and scope selection cannot silently downgrade

steps.event: P selects the extension and an exact grant but W advertises only ordinary core or installs different bytes.
expect: No bilateral activation and no core refusal
No work starts and no prior disposition is revealed

steps.event: Present an unsupported derived proof, an oversized proof, or a proof containing a URL for key discovery.
expect: Setup rejects the unsupported or oversized proof within configured bounds
No untrusted lookup and no ordinary-core fallback

cases.name: naming trust, resource policy and issuance authority are independent

steps.event: A configured naming certifier signs a grant for a represented action it may not confer.
expect: Setup fails

steps.event: An authorized resource issuer signs a grant and both peers activate. The receiver then locally denies the operation.
expect: Fresh protected request receives not-authorized
No effect is performed

cases.name: new protected action uses exact original association

steps.event: Use a structurally valid first-seen request with a different certified key for the same holder principal. Repeat separately with on_behalf_of naming another subject or a request for doc-y under a doc-x grant.
expect: On an otherwise authorized route and valid scope the respective request receives not-authorized
No independent holder privilege supplies fallback

cases.name: ambiguity cannot authorize a contribution or answer

steps.event: Under an otherwise current grant, send a say whose reference matches an opening and a question.
expect: Core malformed reference outcome
Apply to neither target

steps.event: Send a fresh say to a valid open target with an amendment that exceeds the granted resource scope.
expect: Refuse not-authorized
Retain the original work constraints

cases.name: known target stop does not authorize another target

steps.event: With an admitted opening and only a read action permission, send a first-seen stop for that opening.
expect: Refuse not-authorized
No stopped result or suppression marker

steps.event: In an independent matched setup with stop permission for the known target, send a stop for that target.
expect: Apply core stop to that target only

cases.name: stop before opening with established target authority

steps.event: Under an active fixed-subject association, send a stop for unseen S, with permission covering all eligible openings for S.
expect: Accept stop with core ack and scoped prospective suppression

steps.event: Deliver a fresh, otherwise authorized opening S under the same association.
expect: Report taken:not-acted-on
Produce no turn, result or protected effect

cases.name: stop before opening without established target authority

steps.event: Send a stop for unseen S. The grant covers some possible targets, and no trusted facts establish coverage for S.
expect: Refuse not-authorized
Create no suppression marker

steps.event: Deliver an otherwise authorized opening S.
expect: Evaluate ordinary opening admission
Do not treat earlier refusal as suppression

cases.name: approval grants do not inherit from turn scope

steps.event: P offers its read grant as authority to initiate an approval or decide a pending actor-originated approval.
expect: Refuse not-authorized if that specific action or decision is outside the grant
Do not create or decide an approval

steps.event: In a separate scope, P has permission for the exact actor-originated approval and submits a timely correctly bound decision.
expect: Core originator accepts that decision and retains ownership of closure

steps.event: P attempts to close the actor-owned approval.
expect: Core not-authorized ownership outcome
No new closure

cases.name: approval deadlines and exact decision binding remain in force

steps.event: Under otherwise sufficient delegated decision authority, submit a decision without its required digest. Separately submit a correctly bound decision after the owner expires the approval.
expect: Core binding or lifecycle failure applies
Neither decision is accepted

cases.name: exact copy after grant expiry reports old admission only

steps.event: Admit an authorized opening and retain its disposition, then advance the receiver clock to grant expiry.
expect: Old admission remains recorded

steps.event: Deliver the exact signed opening again on a route currently authorized to inspect that disposition.
expect: Return eligible minimal core ack
No repeated effect or cached result disclosure

steps.event: Deliver a distinct fresh opening with all ordinary core checks passing under the same expired association.
expect: Refuse not-authorized
Do not admit or execute new work

cases.name: audience loss precedes retained disposition selection

steps.event: After accepting a protected request, receive both an exact copy and a fresh opening on an unauthorized route in separate runs.
expect: Use the same generic WebSocket 1008 outcome for both
No core disposition, new reservation or protected disclosure

cases.name: conflicting request identity precedes fresh grant authorization

steps.event: Admit a request. Re-sign different structurally valid bytes using the same scoped message ID, after expiry, with route and core authentication otherwise valid.
expect: Core conflicting-ID failure remains malformed
Original disposition unchanged

cases.name: protected effect is checked after admission

steps.event: Admit a grant-dependent write. Before committing it, advance the test clock to expiry or record an authorized local denial.
expect: Preserve prior admission
The resource owner refuses the protected effect under the test resource contract
No rollback promise or invented terminal state

cases.name: local denial during admission and guarded retirement

steps.event: Queue a verified opening and pause before semantic admission. In separate runs, record local grant denial or retire the original scope.
expect: On resumption do not admit on earlier checks
Use not-authorized for the denied grant on a valid route and the binding outcome when scope is retired

cases.name: renewal and reconnect require a fresh scope

steps.event: Replace the connection and grant, provisioning a fresh conversation. Deliver a signed opening for the old conversation on the new connection.
expect: Use generic binding rejection
No old turn or approval moves to the new association

steps.event: Try replacing grant bytes in place on an active scope.
expect: No in-place replacement or reauthorization of queued frames

cases.name: late actor reply and owner closure use own authority

steps.event: After requester grant expiry, the actor emits a valid result for previously admitted work while authorized to disclose it. The requester separately closes its own pending approval via ordinary core rules.
expect: Apply core role and ownership checks
No fresh delegated grant is required solely to report the result or exercise authorized owner closure

steps.event: Repeat with disclosure no longer authorized.
expect: Hold protected outbound content and preserve delivery uncertainty

cases.name: proxy cannot apply its outward grant to an excessive UI instruction

steps.event: U is authorized only to request history from P, while P separately has publication authority at W. U asks P to publish.
expect: P refuses the protected instruction
No downstream publication request or effect

steps.event: P sends a separately authorized worker request under its distinct grant.
expect: W can establish P acting for H
No assertion that H personally signed or that W verified the original UI instruction

cases.name: authority does not imply shared budgets

steps.event: Set up with a grant whose permission parameters include an unsupported shared quota or one-time use condition.
expect: Reject setup rather than omitting the condition
No use accounting promise inferred

cases.name: issuer grant identity conflict does not replace an active association

steps.event: Admit work using a valid grant. During new setup authenticate different compact bytes with the same issuer and grant ID in the same namespace.
expect: Reject the conflicting setup
Do not change the original association or its dispositions

steps.event: Send a fresh protected request on the original still-authorized route after the receiver knows the conflict.
expect: Refuse not-authorized
Preserve the earlier admitted work and its authorized disposition feedback

cases.name: same key renewal and holder rotation have separate effects

steps.event: During grant validity, renew the requester certificate for the same signing key and send a fresh authorized opening.
expect: Evaluate normally under the original grant and scope
Grant expiry remains unchanged

steps.event: Use the new certificate for a different key for another fresh protected request in the original scope, with all other guards satisfied.
expect: Refuse not-authorized
A grant bound to the new key and fresh setup are needed for represented work
